concepts.prompt: Real unedited phone photo of a white fridge door with a few magnets and a child's school calendar: a yellow lined note held by a magnet, hand-written in blue ballpoint: "Retainer: 5 min in the cleaner. NOT the toothbrush!" with the word NOT underlined twice. Below, on the kitchen counter in front of the fridge, the white DentalPULSE Pod from the reference photo with two clear retainers next to it: one milky, cloudy and yellow-tinted with white chalky spots, one crystal clear. Natural kitchen light, slight grain.  IMPORTANT: render ONLY the exact quoted words, spelled exactly; no other text, no real platform logos. Must look like a real photo/screenshot, not an AI render.

concepts.prompt: Real product photograph on a soft pale-blue backdrop: the three items of the Ultimate Cleaning Bundle from the reference photo at their true relative sizes (the white DentalPULSE Pod as the hero, the small Travel Pod, and the blue box of tablets), with two aligner trays in front: one cloudy with a white film and yellow tint, one crystal clear. Lower left, a navy rounded pill with white Barlow Bold text "SAVE $130: $169.95" and under it small navy text "was $300". IMPORTANT: no text anywhere except the small quoted labels above (if any), spelled exactly, in a clean sans-serif like Inter; no logos, no competitor names. Must look like a real unretouched photograph, not an AI render. Realistic scale: the Pod is always clearly larger than any dental appliance. CRITICAL COLOR: every dirty appliance is UNMISTAKABLY dirty at first glance: amber-yellow tint, cloudy milky film, dull patches and white chalky deposits, clearly different from a crystal-clear clean one. It is in sharp focus and large enough to read (still under 40% of the Pod's width).
